name: Manifest V3 · Round 1
domainSummary: A Chrome extension platform contract that declares package metadata, permissions, content-script boundaries, event-driven service workers, host access, and remotely hosted code restrictions before an extension may operate.
evidenceBoundary: Do not render Chrome branding, puzzle pieces, browser UI, JSON, permission text, or version numerals. Express declaration and verification as tiered logistics architecture.

researchSources.title: Extensions Manifest V3
researchSources.use: Official manifest, service worker, permissions, content security, and remote-code constraints.

assets.name: Manifest V3 · Canonical Instrument
assets.controlledVariable: refine the accepted baseline into a precise compact technical instrument building; emphasize declarative package contract
assets.thesis: The accepted skill identity is tested in its clearest production form. This version emphasizes declarative package contract.

assets.name: Manifest V3 · Core Mechanism
assets.controlledVariable: make the skill's defining mechanism the central architectural mass; emphasize least-privilege permission gates
assets.thesis: One unmistakable mechanism carries the identity. This version emphasizes least-privilege permission gates.

assets.name: Manifest V3 · Flow Spine
assets.controlledVariable: organize inputs, work, and outputs along one connected linear spine; emphasize event-driven service worker
assets.thesis: A legible flow tests the skill as a transformation process. This version emphasizes event-driven service worker.

assets.name: Manifest V3 · Interface Bridge
assets.controlledVariable: join two unequal functional masses through one explicit inhabited interface bridge; emphasize isolated content-script boundary
assets.thesis: The skill is expressed as a reliable boundary between systems. This version emphasizes isolated content-script boundary.

assets.name: Manifest V3 · Layered System
assets.controlledVariable: stack several connected layers with visibly different responsibilities; emphasize packaged-code verification
assets.thesis: Layering tests separation of concerns and system depth. This version emphasizes packaged-code verification.

assets.name: Manifest V3 · Modular Field
assets.controlledVariable: repeat small interoperable units on one shared base with a clear coordinating core; emphasize declarative package contract
assets.thesis: Modularity and composition become the identity. This version emphasizes declarative package contract.

assets.name: Manifest V3 · Verified Core
assets.controlledVariable: protect a compact central chamber behind explicit gates, checks, or controlled thresholds; emphasize least-privilege permission gates
assets.thesis: Correctness and validation dominate the architectural metaphor. This version emphasizes least-privilege permission gates.

assets.name: Manifest V3 · Scale Engine
assets.controlledVariable: extend the building through repeated service bays and resilient parallel paths; emphasize event-driven service worker
assets.thesis: Performance and scale are expressed through structure, not speed lines. This version emphasizes event-driven service worker.

assets.name: Manifest V3 · Compact Primitive
assets.controlledVariable: reduce the skill to a minimal but complete map-readable technical building; emphasize isolated content-script boundary
assets.thesis: The primitive tests the smallest recognizable expression of the skill. This version emphasizes isolated content-script boundary.

assets.name: Manifest V3 · Skill Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: combine mechanism, flow, interface, validation, and scale in one balanced supporting building; emphasize packaged-code verification
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests a complete skill identity while remaining subordinate to projects and cities. This version emphasizes packaged-code verification.
